_comment: slm-lab scaffold -- EXAMPLE config (a template to adapt, not a live config).
Copy the models block into your own config (~/.jichi or local/config.json)
and fill in your provider/model/apiBase. Secret-free: the key comes from an
env var named by apiKeyEnv, never a literal key here.
A chat model is all you need, and a local one is free and private (LM Studio,
llama.cpp, Ollama); see docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md. The training itself runs in
charlm, on your CPU -- the model only helps you build, run and read it.
snapshots let you /undo a bad edit to charlm.c; pathFence keeps file writes
inside this workspace. testCommand builds charlm with strict warnings.
